title: Nyansa Nne
intro: Nyansa nne a ɛyɛ brɛoo bi kaa afotu a ɛboro bere so bere bi. Saa akontaabu yi a wɔde ntease a emu dɔ hyiraa no no de asuade ahorow a ɛsom bo a ɛda so ara yɛ kanea ma wɔn a wɔn kɔn dɔ akwankyerɛ nyinaa mae. So wubetumi ahu onii ko a ɛwɔ nsɛm a ɛtra hɔ daa yi akyi?
clues: Wɔmaa me nhyira a emu dɔ a ɛfiri Allah hɔ, akyɛdeɛ a ɛmaa m’akoma ne m’adwene mu hann.
Medan kɔɔ me ba a medɔ no no nkyɛn, a na mepɛ sɛ mekyɛ ademude a ɛsom bo sen biara a mewɔ no.
Mebɔɔ kɔkɔ sɛ ntɛnkyea a emu yɛ den sen biara ne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ ahokafo ne nokware Nyankopɔn Baako no.
Mekaee sɛ sinapi aba mu duru mpo, a wɔde asie ɔbotan mu anaa esoro akyi no, Allah bɛbu akontaa.
Mehyɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ asɛdeɛ mma awofoɔ, ɛwom sɛ osetie wɔ trenee ho nsɛm nko ara mu de.
Mekyerɛkyerɛɛ suban a ɛnyɛ den: fa ahobrɛase nantew asase so na brɛ wo nne ase; efisɛ nnyigyei a ano yɛ den sen biara ne mfurum a wɔrebɔ ose.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
